description: Department of Archaeology - Order under Antiquities Ordinance that declaring the 58 Monuments as "Protected Monuments" under Anti Quities Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of ancient monuments as protected monuments under the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188). It constitutes a regulatory action by the Minister of Education exercising powers granted by existing legislation. The content focuses on establishing legal protection status for specific archaeological sites and structures, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
